questions.question: World Braille Day is celebrated on: विश्व ब्रेल दिवस मनाया जाता है:
questions.solution:
World Braille Day is observed on January 4th to commemorate the birth of Louis Braille (1809), the inventor of the Braille system, which is used by visually impaired people worldwide for reading and writing.

The day was established to raise awareness about the importance of Braille as a means of communication for the blind and visually impaired.

Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is celebrated on January 9th to mark the return of Mahatma Gandhi from South Africa to India in 1915, a pivotal moment in India's freedom struggle.

The day is dedicated to the Indian diaspora and their contributions to the country.

questions.solution:
• January 23: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's birth anniversary is celebrated as Desh Prem Divas or Parakram Divas to honor his contributions to India's freedom struggle.

• January 24: National Girl Child Day was established in 2008 by the Ministry of Women and Child Development to promote awareness about the rights of the girl child and to improve their status in society.

• January 25: National Voters Day was established in 2011 to encourage voter participation, especially among young voters.

• January 26: India's Republic Day marks the day when the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950, making India a sovereign republic.

World Leprosy Day is observed on the last Sunday of January to raise awareness about Hansen's Disease (leprosy) and to reduce the stigma associated with it. The day aims to promote early detection and treatment of the disease.

Further insights:

o World Health Day (April 7) focuses on global health issues.

o World Red Cross Day (May 8) honors the principles of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

o World Cancer Day (February 4) raises awareness about cancer prevention and treatment.

questions.question: World Wetland Day is observed on: विश्व वेटलैंड दिवस कब मनाया जाता है:
questions.solution:
World Wetland Day is observed on February 2nd to commemorate the adoption of the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands in 1971.

The convention aims to conserve and sustainably use wetlands, which are critical for biodiversity and human well-being.

October 2nd marks Mahatma Gandhi's birthday and is observed as the International Day of Non-violence, as established by the United Nations in 2007. The day promotes the principles of non-violence and peace, inspired by Gandhi's philosophy.

• Further insights:

o World Food Day (October 16) focuses on global hunger and food security.

o World Animal Welfare Day (October 4) promotes animal rights and welfare.

o World Habitat Day (first Monday of October) raises awareness about urban development and housing.

National Science Day is celebrated on February 28th to mark the discovery of the Raman Effect by Sir C.V. Raman in 1928.

For this discovery, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930. The day aims to promote scientific temper and innovation in India.

questions.solution:
• World Wildlife Day: March 3

o World Wildlife Day was established by the United Nations General Assembly on December 20, 2013, and is celebrated annually on March 3rd, coinciding with the anniversary of the adoption of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) in 1973.

• National Security Day: March 4

o In India, March 04 is celebrated as National Security Day (Rastriya Suraksha Diwas) every year, in the honour of the Indian Security Forces.

• International Women's Day: March 8

o IWD celebrates women's social, economic, cultural, and political achievements and calls for action to accelerate gender equality.

• World Consumer Rights Day: March 15

o World Consumer Rights Day was inspired by President John F Kennedy, who sent a special message to the US Congress on 15th March 1962, in which he formally addressed the issue of consumer rights.

questions.solution:
• June 5: World Environment Day

o Led by the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and held annually on 5 June since 1973, World Environment Day is the largest global platform for environmental public outreach and is celebrated by millions of people across the world.

• June 14: World Blood Donor Day

o World Blood Donor Day, celebrated annually on 14 June, is a worldwide celebration to honour and thank those people who donate their blood, voluntarily and unpaid, to give others the gift of life. It is celebrated on the day of birthday anniversary of Karl Landsteiner, who discovered the ABO blood group system.

• June 21: International Yoga Day

o Recognizing its universal appeal, on 11 December 2014, the United Nations proclaimed 21 June as the International Day of Yoga by resolution 69/131. The International Day of Yoga aims to raise awareness worldwide of the many benefits of practicing yoga.

• June 20: World Refugee Day

o World Refugee Day is an international day organised every year on 20 June by the United Nations. It is designed to celebrate and honour refugees from around the world. The day was first established on 20 June 2001, in recognition of the 50th anniversary of the 1951 Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees.

questions.question: World Water Day is celebrated on: विश्व जल दिवस कब मनाया जाता है:
questions.solution: World Water Day is observed on March 22nd annually to highlight the importance of freshwater and advocate for sustainable management of water resources.

National Doctor's Day in India is observed on July 1st to honor the legendary physician Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy, who was born and died on the same day (July 1).

He was a prominent doctor and the second Chief Minister of West Bengal.

March 23rd marks the day when freedom fighters Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev Thapar, and Shivaram Rajguru were hanged in 1931 during India's struggle for independence.

The day is observed to honor their sacrifice.

World Sight Day is observed on the second Thursday of October to focus global attention on blindness and vision impairment.

The day aims to promote eye health and reduce preventable blindness.

questions.question: World Autism Awareness Day is celebrated on: विश्व ऑटिज्म जागरूकता दिवस मनाया जाता है:
questions.solution: World Autism Awareness Day is observed on April 2nd as established by the United Nations to raise awareness about autism spectrum disorders and promote inclusion and support for individuals with autism.

The International Day for Mine Awareness and Assistance in Mine Action is observed on April 4th to raise awareness about landmines and promote actions toward their eradication.

The day also focuses on assisting victims of landmines.

World Health Day is celebrated on April 7th to mark the founding of the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1948.

The day focuses on global health issues and promotes healthier living.

Constitution Day in India is observed on November 26th to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.

The Constitution came into effect on January 26, 1950.

questions.question: National Panchayati Raj Diwas is observed on: राष्ट्रीय पंचायती राज दिवस मनाया जाता है:
questions.solution: National Panchayati Raj Diwas is observed on April 24th to mark the enactment of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment in 1993, which institutionalized the Panchayati Raj system in India, promoting local self-governance.

questions.question: World Press Freedom Day is observed on: विश्व प्रेस स्वतंत्रता दिवस मनाया जाता है:
questions.solution:
World Press Freedom Day is observed globally on May 3rd each year.

It was proclaimed by the UN General Assembly in 1993 to raise awareness about the importance of press freedom and to defend the media from attacks on their independence.

National Mathematics Day in India is celebrated on December 22nd to commemorate the birth anniversary of the mathematical genius Srinivas Ramanujan.

The day aims to promote the study of mathematics and inspire young minds.
